threads.name: The Influence of the Francis Bartlett Donation
threads.description: This theme explores how the Francis Bartlett Donation of 1900 and 1912 facilitated the acquisition of significant artworks across multiple stops, showcasing the impact of philanthropic contributions on the museum's collection.

threads.name: Philanthropy and Artistic Enrichment
threads.description: This theme examines the role of various donors and trusts in enriching the museum's collection, illustrating how philanthropy has shaped the diversity and depth of the museum's holdings over time.

threads_active.name: Philanthropy and Artistic Enrichment
element_summaries: The Loïs Mailou Jones Pierre-Noël Trust gifted the artwork 'Negro Student' to the museum.
The Museum purchased a marble statue of Juno with funds donated by George D. and Margo Behrakis.
W. G. Russell Allen bequeathed the lithograph 'Woman Seated in a Loge' to the museum.
